page_title: STU 2-0 UNI | Stuttgart v Union Berlin 08/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+3' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) takes a short corner kick.
90+2' Chris Bedia (Union Berlin) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Stuttgart.
88' The ball is cleared after Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
85' A corner kick by Union Berlin is thwarted by the well prepared Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart).
85' It seemed like Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
84' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
82' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Angelo Stiller.
82' That will be all from Chris Fuhrich who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
82' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chris Bedia (Union Berlin) replacing Robin Gosens.
82' Substitution. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) has come on for Diogo Leite.

81' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Frederik Ronnow!

78' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
77' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
75' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) passes the ball onto Brenden Aaronson, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
73' A substitution has been made. Kevin Volland is replaced by Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin).
71' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
67' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
66' Here is a change. Rani Khedira is going off and Nenad Bjelica gives the last tactical orders to Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
66' Today's match ends for Yorbe Vertessen who will be replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
65' 2 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the top right corner.
65' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) and Rani Khedira matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
64' A lofted cross from Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
60' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Enzo Millot will be replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).
60' The referee signals a substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is brought on as a substitute for Pascal Stenzel.
59' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
54' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sprays a pass out to Pascal Stenzel, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.

52' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Frederik Ronnow sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
52' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) smashes the ball upfield and Robin Gosens brings it down with a fine first touch.
49' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
48' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
48' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
46' Sebastian Hoeness makes a half-time substitution. Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) comes on in place of Anthony Rouault.
46' Robert Schroder blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
45+1' Serhou Guirassy is picked out by Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
41' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
39' Yellow card. Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
38' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
33' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Alexander Nubel.
32' It seemed like Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
31' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
29' Stuttgart hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
28' Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) brings his opponent down. Robert Schroder has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

19' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a precise through ball from Atakan Karazor before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
17' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

16' What a wasted opportunity by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Alexander Nubel makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
15' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Schroder blows for a foul.

12' Ambitious effort from Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
11' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
10' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) delivers a long cross in an attempt to surprise the opponent's sleepy defence.
7' One of the players from Stuttgart times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
3' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
